name: mcp.usewheelhouse.com
description: Wheelhouse is a revenue management and dynamic pricing platform for short-term rental operators. It sets and adjusts nightly rates for Airbnb, VRBO, and Booking.com listings using real-time market, comp set, and demand data, and integrates with the PMS platforms operators already run on, including Guesty, Hostaway, Hospitable, Mews, Cloudbeds, Lodgify, OwnerRez, Hostfully, Smoobu, Uplisting, Track, Streamline, and Escapia. Wheelhouse’s open API enables growth workflows built on top of its data — including owner communications, owner retention, and listing acquisition — alongside its core revenue management tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.usewheelhouse.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.usewheelhouse.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.usewheelhouse.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.usewheelhouse.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.usewheelhouse.com provides these MCP tools: execute, get_schema, and search.
